title.es: This, that, these, those (este, ese, aquel)

text.en: This / that / these / those are demonstratives: they point to the thing you are talking about. English has two distances: NEAR (this, these) and FAR (that, those). Spanish has three (este, ese, aquel), so both “ese” and “aquel” become “that”. There is no gender either: “este libro” and “esta casa” are both “this”. You only track number: singular this / that, plural these / those.
text.es: This / that / these / those son demostrativos: señalan de qué cosa hablas. El inglés tiene dos distancias: CERCA (this, these) y LEJOS (that, those). El español tiene tres (este, ese, aquel), así que tanto «ese» como «aquel» se convierten en «that». Tampoco hay género: «este libro» y «esta casa» son ambos «this». Solo cuentas el número: singular this / that, plural these / those.

text.en: On their own (as pronouns): This is my bag. These are my friends. After this / that use “is”, after these / those use “are”.
text.es: Solos (como pronombres): This is my bag. These are my friends. Después de this / that va «is», después de these / those va «are».

text.en: Before a noun (as determiners): this / that go with a singular noun, these / those with a plural noun. This book, but these books.
text.es: Delante de un nombre (como determinantes): this / that van con un nombre singular, these / those con uno plural. This book, pero these books.

text.en: Questions: What’s this? Who is that? Is this your phone? “That” can point to a person too, if the person is far away.
text.es: Preguntas: What’s this? Who is that? Is this your phone? «That» también puede señalar a una persona, si está lejos.

text.en: Short answers: “it” replaces this / that and “they” replaces these / those. Is this your bag? Yes, it is. Are those your books? No, they aren’t.
text.es: Respuesta corta: «it» sustituye a this / that y «they» sustituye a these / those. Is this your bag? Yes, it is. Are those your books? No, they aren’t.

examples.es: Is this your phone? Yes, it is.

tr.en: Is this your phone? Yes, it is.

examples.es: Are those your keys? No, they aren't.

tr.en: Are those your keys? No, they aren't.

text.en: Careful: the demonstrative agrees with the number of the noun. Do not say “this books”; say “these books”. Do not say “that houses”; say “those houses”.
text.es: Cuidado: el demostrativo concuerda en número con el nombre. No digas «this books», di «these books»; y no «that houses», sino «those houses».

text.en: In a short answer do not repeat the demonstrative: instead of “Is this your bag? Yes, this is.” say “Yes, it is.” In the plural: “Yes, they are.”
text.es: En la respuesta corta no repitas el demostrativo: en vez de «Is this your bag? Yes, this is.» di «Yes, it is.» En plural: «Yes, they are.»

text.en: Spanish “ese” and “aquel” are both “that” in English (“those” in the plural). If you need to be precise, add a place word: that book there, that house over there.
text.es: El español «ese» y «aquel» son ambos «that» en inglés («those» en plural). Si quieres precisar, añade una palabra de lugar: that book there, that house over there.

speak.en: This, that, these and those point to things. «This» and «these» are for things that are near, «that» and «those» for things that are far. Singular: «this book», «that house». Plural: «these books», «those houses». Questions: «What is this?», «Who is that?». In a short answer use «it» or «they»: «Is this your bag? Yes, it is.» Careful: do not say «this books», say «these books».
speak.es: This, that, these y those son demostrativos. «This» y «these» son para cosas cercanas, «that» y «those» para cosas lejanas. Singular: «this book», «that house». Plural: «these books», «those houses». Preguntas: «What is this?», «Who is that?». En la respuesta corta se usa «it» o «they»: «Is this your bag? Yes, it is.» Cuidado: no digas «this books», di «these books».

why.en: “Here” means near, and “book” is singular: This book here is new.
why.es: «Here» indica cerca, y «book» es singular: This book here is new.

That.en: “That” is for something far; “here” means near: this.
That.es: «That» es para algo lejano; «here» indica cerca: this.

These.en: “These” is plural; “book” is singular: this book.
These.es: «These» es plural; «book» es singular: this book.

tr.es: Este libro de aquí es nuevo.

why.en: “There” means far, and “house” is singular: That house there is big.
why.es: «There» indica lejos, y «house» es singular: That house there is big.

This.en: “This” is for something near; “there” means far: that.
This.es: «This» es para algo cercano; «there» indica lejos: that.

Those.en: “Those” is plural; “house” is singular: that house.
Those.es: «Those» es plural; «house» es singular: that house.

tr.es: Esa casa de allá es grande.

why.en: “Here” means near, and “books” is plural: These books here are new.
why.es: «Here» indica cerca, y «books» es plural: These books here are new.

This.en: “This” is singular; “books” is plural: these books.
This.es: «This» es singular; «books» es plural: these books.

Those.en: “Those” is for things far away; “here” means near: these.
Those.es: «Those» es para cosas lejanas; «here» indica cerca: these.

tr.es: Estos libros de aquí son nuevos.

why.en: “There” means far, and “cars” is plural: Those cars there are red.
why.es: «There» indica lejos, y «cars» es plural: Those cars there are red.

That.en: “That” is singular; “cars” is plural: those cars.
That.es: «That» es singular; «cars» es plural: those cars.

These.en: “These” is for things near; “there” means far: those.
These.es: «These» es para cosas cercanas; «there» indica lejos: those.

tr.es: Esos carros de allá son rojos.

wrong.en: “These” is for near things; “those” is for far ones: Those are my friends (over there).
wrong.es: «These» es para cosas cercanas; «those» para las lejanas: Those are my friends (allí).
«Friends» y «are» son plural, por eso «those», no «that».

why.en: “Are” and “friends” are plural, and “here” means near: These are my friends here.
why.es: «Are» y «friends» son plural, y «here» indica cerca: These are my friends here.

This.en: “This” is singular and takes “is”: This is my friend.
This.es: «This» es singular y lleva «is»: This is my friend.

That.en: “That” is singular and points far away: That is my friend.
That.es: «That» es singular y señala lejos: That is my friend.

tr.es: Estos de aquí son mis amigos.

items.sentence: Is this your bag? Yes, ___ is.

why.en: In a short answer “it” replaces this / that: Yes, it is.
why.es: En la respuesta corta «it» sustituye a this / that: Yes, it is.

this.en: In a short answer we do not repeat “this”; we say “it”.
this.es: En la respuesta corta no se repite «this», se dice «it».

that.en: “That” points far away; the answer uses “it”: Yes, it is.
that.es: «That» señala lejos; la respuesta usa «it»: Yes, it is.

examples: Is that your car? Yes, it is.
Is this your phone? No, it is not.

tr.en: Is this your bag? Yes, it is.
tr.es: ¿Esta es tu bolsa? Sí, lo es.

items.sentence: Are those your books? Yes, ___ are.

why.en: In a short answer “they” replaces these / those: Yes, they are.
why.es: En la respuesta corta «they» sustituye a these / those: Yes, they are.

those.en: In a short answer we do not repeat “those”; we say “they”.
those.es: En la respuesta corta no se repite «those», se dice «they».

these.en: “These” points near; the answer uses “they”: Yes, they are.
these.es: «These» señala cerca; la respuesta usa «they»: Yes, they are.

examples: Are these your keys? Yes, they are.
Are those your friends? No, they are not.

tr.en: Are those your books? Yes, they are.
tr.es: ¿Esos son tus libros? Sí, lo son.

why.en: “Over there” means far, and “what’s” is singular: What’s that over there?
why.es: «Over there» indica lejos, y «what’s» es singular: What’s that over there?

this.en: “This” is for something near; “over there” means far: that.
this.es: «This» es para algo cercano; «over there» indica lejos: that.

these.en: “These” is plural; “what’s” (what is) is singular: that.
these.es: «These» es plural; «what’s» (what is) es singular: that.

items.sentence: This is my bag, and ___ is your bag over there.

why.en: The second bag is far away (“over there”) and singular: that.
why.es: La segunda bolsa está lejos («over there») y es singular: that.

those.en: “Those” is plural; here we talk about one bag, and “is” needs a singular.
those.es: «Those» es plural; aquí se habla de una bolsa, y «is» pide un singular.

these.en: “These” is plural and near; “is” needs a singular, and the bag is far away.
these.es: «These» es plural y cercano; «is» pide un singular, y la bolsa está lejos.

examples: This is my car, and that is your car.
This is my house, and that is your house.

tr.en: This is my bag, and that is your bag over there.
tr.es: Esta es mi bolsa y esa de allá es tu bolsa.

items.es: Is this your bag? Yes, it is.

tr.en: Is this your bag? Yes, it is.

text.es: respuesta corta: «it» sustituye a this / that

wrong.en: In a short answer we do not repeat the demonstrative; we say “it”: Yes, it is.
wrong.es: En la respuesta corta no se repite el demostrativo, se dice «it»: Yes, it is.

wrong.en: The question uses to be (“Is…”), so the answer does too: Yes, it is, not “Yes, it does”.
wrong.es: La pregunta usa to be («Is…»), así que la respuesta también: Yes, it is, no «Yes, it does».

why.en: “Man” is singular and far away (“over there”): that man.
why.es: «Man» es singular y está lejos («over there»): that man.

those.en: “Those” is plural; “man” is singular: that man.
those.es: «Those» es plural; «man» es singular: that man.

these.en: “These” is plural and near; “man” is singular and far away: that man.
these.es: «These» es plural y cercano; «man» es singular y está lejos: that man.

examples: Who is that boy over there?

tr.en: Who is that man over there?

why.en: After “these” comes a plural noun: These houses are big.
why.es: Después de «these» va un nombre en plural: These houses are big.

house.en: “These” is plural, “house” is singular: these houses.
house.es: «These» es plural, «house» es singular: these houses.

a house.en: There is no “a” after “these”: “a” goes before a singular noun.
a house.es: Después de «these» no va «a»: «a» va delante de un nombre singular.

why.en: After “that” comes a singular noun: That cat is small.
why.es: Después de «that» va un nombre en singular: That cat is small.

cats.en: “That” is singular, “cats” is plural: that cat.
cats.es: «That» es singular, «cats» es plural: that cat.

cates.en: “Cates” does not exist; “that” needs the singular: cat.
cates.es: «Cates» no existe; «that» necesita el singular: cat.

why.en: “That’s” = that is, singular, for a person far away: That’s my brother over there.
why.es: «That’s» = that is, singular, para una persona lejana: That’s my brother over there.

These.en: “These” is plural and needs “are”; here we talk about one brother.
These.es: «These» es plural y necesita «are»; aquí se habla de un hermano.

Those.en: “Those” is plural and needs “are”; here we talk about one brother.
Those.es: «Those» es plural y necesita «are»; aquí se habla de un hermano.

tr.es: Ese de allá es mi hermano.

text.en: singular, near: this (also to introduce a person)
text.es: singular, cerca: this (también para presentar a una persona)

text.en: “this” can only point to things, not people
text.es: «this» solo puede señalar cosas, no personas

wrong.en: “This” can point to people too, especially when introducing someone: This is my sister.
wrong.es: «This» también puede señalar a personas, sobre todo al presentar a alguien: This is my sister.

why.en: “Shoes” is plural, and “here” means near: I like these shoes here.
why.es: «Shoes» es plural, y «here» indica cerca: I like these shoes here.

this.en: “This” is singular; “shoes” is plural: these shoes.
this.es: «This» es singular; «shoes» es plural: these shoes.

those.en: “Those” points far away; “here” means near: these.

tr.es: Me gustan estos zapatos de aquí.
